Function Documentation

void audio_test_pattern (float * output, size_t count, uint64_t position, uint32_t sample_rate)

Generate a bounded, repeating 20-second mono diagnostic phrase. Position is in samples at sample_rate; arbitrary block sizes are equivalent. No allocations or mutable global state. Peak amplitude is at most 0.18.
